d: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney is making headlines at the APEC summit in China after delivering sharp remarks on Russia, Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump. Carney pushed back against Putin’s claim that Western sanctions have lost their impact, saying the measures remain effective and will continue to increase while the war in Ukraine goes on. He also discussed Canada’s expanding trade relationship with China, including efforts to open markets for Canadian exports and diversify economic partnerships beyond the United States.
